entities.summary: Adolfo Tito Camacho Yllana is a Filipino prelate of the Catholic Church who works in the diplomatic service of the Holy See. He has been an archbishop and apostolic nuncio since 2001, the Apostolic Nuncio to Israel as well as Apostolic Delegate to Jerusalem and Palestine from June 2021 to January 2026.
